name: Ashok Yuvajana Sangam
known_for: Organized and sponsored by prominent local leader/MLA T. Padma Rao Goud. It is one of the most culturally active and visited community-led pandals in Secunderabad.
theme: Features a mini moving-statue drama (mechanical figures) or a short digital projection/laser show paired with high-energy audio dialogues, retelling a mythological story (such as Ganesha's birth, Lord Shiva vs. Demons, or The story of the Mushika)

name: Secunderabad Ka Raja
known_for: The organizing Dundigalla family shares a long-standing association with the Congress party, notably driven by leaders like Nagendhar Raj and Mallikarjun Dundigalla.
theme: Historically inspired royalty themes. The idol is designed to look like a regal king sitting on a grand throne ("Raja" style)

name: Khairatabad Ganesh
known_for: Tallest and most iconic Ganesh idol in Telangana; massive crowds and elaborate mythological sets
theme: 2026: Panchamukha Sankatahara Maha Ganapati (5-faced form), with a 15-ft Somnath Jyotirlinga and Kalika Mata replica alongside

name: Ghasmandi Ka Raja
known_for: Celebrated as "Ghasmandi Ka Raja". It is heavily patronized by the family of Talasani Srinivas Yadav (and his son Talasani Sai Kiran Yadav), serving as a core festive base for the BRS (Bharat Rashtra Samithi) party cadre in the Secunderabad constituency area.
theme: Grand traditional and regional mythological themes. It often incorporates grand temple-style backdrops and sets reflecting Telangana's heritage.

name: Ganesh Friends Association
known_for: Organized and anchored by the family and followers of senior BJP leader Bhawarlal Varma. It acts as a major political-religious focal point on Subhash Road, regularly welcoming top-tier state and national BJP leadership
theme: The decorations regularly incorporate historical fort structures, replicas of ancient temples, or themes celebrating cultural nationalism.

name: YMCA Ganesha
known_for: Famous as "YMCA Ganesha", it is traditionally the second-tallest idol in the twin cities. It is uniquely organized by the Adarsh Lorry Owners Association.
theme: Monumental grandeur. The theme focuses on scale and massive structural artistry, presenting Lord Ganesha in iconic, towering postures mimicking prominent heritage temple deities.

name: Ramnagar Siddiq Bhai Ganesh
known_for: Global symbol of communal harmony; organized by a Muslim devotee (Mohammed Siddiq) along with Hindu-Muslim youth networks for 20+ years.
theme: Communal Unity & Grand Royal Devotion; famous for presenting a massive 786-kg laddu offering

name: Ramnagar Ka Raja
known_for: The premier heavyweight neighborhood pandal famous for adopting a high-energy Mumbai-style Dhol Tasha agaman (arrival) procession.
theme: Regal King (Raja) on massive ornamental thrones with hyper-realistic clay craftsmanship.

name: TEAM TRT GANESH
known_for: Famous as 'TRT Ka Raja'. Renowned for holding one of the earliest and largest Mumbai-style high-energy public arrival (Aagaman) processions in the area.
theme: Grand Regal King theme ('Raja' style) set inside highly detailed, heavy structural backdrops

name: Balapur Ganesh
known_for: Landmark pioneer of the city-wide festival. Most famous globally for initiating the historic 21-kg Golden Laddu (Bangaru Laddu) open auction that officially flags off Hyderabad's grand immersion procession (Shobha Yatra) every year.
theme: Traditional royal postures combined with grand replicas of iconic Indian temples (such as the Arunachalam or Kanaka Durga temple sets) built by specialized artisans.

name: Shiva Bhajan Samaj
known_for: Being one of the oldest (114 years) traditional Ganesh pandals in Secunderabad, traditional Telangana cultural rituals. Ganesh is placed inside the temple.
theme: A historical local shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva, known for hosting community devotional gatherings and bhajans with a heritage spanning over a century in the area.

name: Hyderabad Ka Raja (Team Netaji / Warasiguda Youth Ganesh)
known_for: Innovative technological themes, grand lighting setups, and hosting 3D Ganesha visual projections and laser shows.
theme: High-tech visual themes, 3D digital projections, and elaborate light illuminations

name: Mettuguda Ayyappa Galli Ganesh Utsav Samithi
